notes.title: "Your Love Story" was finally in the player library of "BREAK BOUNDS: EXILE"
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting! After a week of patient answers and help from Steam, we finally release the "Your Love Story" to the player library of "BREAK BOUNDS: EXILE".

Some connoisseur friends told us, the friends who used the connoisseur key and media key of "BREAK BOUNDS: EXILE" failed to get "Your Love Story". If you have a connoisseur or media key of "BREAK BOUNDS: EXILE", and need to experience "Your Love Story", please contact us via Steam or email.

For any other questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us also.

Thank you for your attention and support.
Ming&Jin
OceanPanda Studio

notes.title: Mysterious surprise gift in August
notes.content:
After the second chapter was updated, as the story experience content of "BreakBounds: Exile" has been for 5-6 hours, the problem of imperfect system has become obvious. We adjusted our previous plan to tell the story first and finally improve the system, and used a small independent project "Your Love Story" to start the adaptation learning of the new system in advance. "Your Love Story" has a complete and independent story experience of about 2 hours, and the production is also very attentive. After completion, it will be put on the shelves as an independent project, but players who bought the Early Access version of "BreakBounds: Exile" will get it for free.

For a long time, we are very grateful to the players who bought the Early Access version of "BreakBounds: Exile" who are still willing to believe, support and accompany us to complete the game with only the first few hours of the plot. Therefore, before "BreakBounds: Exile" is completed, our development time should belong to you who support us. In this process, whether it is the test project of system upgrade or other related art products that may be available in the future, we will package them in this Early Access version for free for everyone to experience.

The following is the store page of "Your Love Story".

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010830/Your_Love_Story

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/af14e635369675ca4493a9e9f7876df8cbb3fce4.jpg[/img]

We will announce the specific completion time of “Your Love Story" in the near future.

Again, thank you for your support and attention. ^^

OceanPanda
Jin&Ming

notes.title: 20220514 version update
notes.content:
For the puzzle in Chapter 2, the option degree of freedom is modified, that is, if the player enters the wrong password twice, he/she can directly ask for the password answer from Anny. If player still want to continue to solve the puzzle, he/she can choose not to get the answer directly, but just ask to repeat the prompt.

Thanks,
Jin&Ming

notes.title: 20220510 Version update
notes.content: After the Chinese version of Chapter 2 was updated, players reported that during the process of load and save, there were images overlapping bug in multiple positions of the game. This update corrected the bug.

notes.title: Chapter 02 was updated on April 28
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your attention and support. Especially the players who purchased game in October 2021, when the game has only 2 hours of experience. We are sincerely grateful for your trust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/d1ac89fa2a72bbbe55d1460a3d22c6796fe1cc51.jpg[/img]

After the game was first released in early access mode in October last year, we immediately entered the continuous development of the game after sorting out and understanding feedbacks from our player for a period of time. This is the first time that our studio published the game on the steam. Steam's release process is still very strange to us. In addition, the contents of the game at that time was very limited. Therefore, we were not active enough in the community and did not provide continuous update information frequently. Thank you for your understanding in this process.

After months of development, adjustment and changes, the Chapter 02 of the game we brought will be much richer than the Chapter 01. In addition to extending the whole game story experience to 5 ~ 6 hours, some further attempts have been added in the gameplay too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/5a5b95a8598f2c386afcc71b29d7d1a14a6b2ca9.jpg[/img]

After that chaotic adaptation period, Dr. Lu will finally begin to adapt to his hard life. During this period, you will gradually start to understand your living environment, your partners and neighbors, your own past, and really start to face the treacherous fate that has never been controlled by you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/bd3151011fc98bb730df5828a6ec7b05fb08f1b6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/f4c4a66473f45a8e92756c2efb26dd95f24c19d6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228360/154679599953a769da3d4984fb6ed6579ac6b0d2.jpg[/img]

Our estimate of the complete game is still the same as the original plan. It is estimated that the story experience content will be 15 ~ 20 hours and about 8 chapters. Of course, according to the average experience time of the current chapters, it is likely that the story experience content of the complete game will exceed 20 hours in the end. Including the number of characters, the expansion of gameplay and other aspects will also be continuously increased and extended according to the previous planning, without any major adjustment in the planning.

At present, the Chinese version of Chapter 2 is updated. The English version of Chapter 2 is still in the localization process. Subsequent updates will be announced separately.

Again,

Thank you for your support and look forward to your suggestions and feedback ~^^

Jin&Ming
